sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about my day so far because my day isn't over yet. It's just beginning.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談到目前為止我的一天，因為我的一天還沒結束。這才剛開始。

sentences.en: Today I woke up at 5 a.m.
sentences.tc: 今天我早上 5 點起床。

sentences.en: It was brutal. Finding the motivation to wake up at 5 a.m. Can be very difficult.
sentences.tc: 這很殘酷。找到凌晨 5 點起床的動力可能非常困難。

sentences.tc: 我可以獨自享受海灘。我跑到海灘。我遊了一會兒泳。

sentences.tc: 我坐在沙上，花了一點時間呼吸和冥想。我稍微伸了個懶腰。

sentences.en: Then I was ready to walk back home.
sentences.tc: 然後我就準備步行回家。

sentences.en: After eating dinner, I take 30 minutes to study Chinese.
sentences.tc: 吃完晚餐後，我花了30分鐘學習中文。

sentences.en: I've been feeling really inspired in learning Chinese lately. It's difficult to find time to study a language every day. I know.
sentences.tc: 最近學習漢語讓我深受啟發。每天很難找到時間學習語言。我知道。

sentences.en: That's why I enjoy trying to make learning English a lot easier.
sentences.tc: 這就是為什麼我喜歡嘗試讓英語學習變得更容易。

sentences.en: I think even five minutes of practicing is more than enough. There's no need to put so much pressure on yourself to study for one hour or two hours a day.
sentences.tc: 我認為練習五分鐘就足夠了。沒必要給自己太大的壓力，每天學習一、兩個小時。
